trigger: Adds and materially changes a Worker Agent tool surface: contained prepared-source list, ranged read and literal search.
proposed_approach: Issue an application-approved prepared-source context whose physical root remains private to Infrastructure. Worker-visible list/read/search arguments cannot select a root. Infrastructure uses bounded handle-relative no-follow traversal, treats every symlink/reparse entry as non-traversable, returns Repository-relative locations and truthful completion states, and rechecks injected current batch/Repository/subject/purpose authority before and during disclosure.
effects: Workers can inspect one approved live prepared directory without Git acquisition, copying, hashing, retention, database, CodeGraph or LSP.
Revoked, changed or unavailable authority closes the context, invalidates continuations, discards buffered output and settles owned work.
Prepared input remains a live operator-labelled origin, not a Profiled Revision or Source Snapshot.
All symlink and reparse traversal is denied, including links that currently point inside the root.
Existing retained Git source behavior remains separate and must pass regression coverage.
implementation_intent: If authorized, generate dependency-ordered tasks for this reviewed design. Later implementation will still require separate approval after complete definition acceptance, behavioral TDD, review, conditional E2E and final verification.
recommendation: Authorize task generation for the independently accepted plan. The main tradeoff is deliberately giving up traversal through otherwise-safe in-root links to keep one race-resistant containment rule.
uncertainty: Windows handle-relative no-follow containment and revocation timing are accepted design obligations but remain unimplemented and unqualified until later test and review gates.
approval_permits: Progression from the accepted plan to task generation for this exact scope.
approval_does_not_permit: Production implementation, database/provider/runtime operations, a broader Scan strategy, PRD changes, or bypassing later analysis, TDD, review, E2E, security and verification gates.
